name: Clumoove
tagline: Self-hosted cloud data migration & sync manager
description:
Clumoove is a modern, self-hosted cloud data migration and synchronization platform for files, calendars, and contacts.

Easily connect, transfer, and synchronize data between cloud storage providers including Nextcloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, HiDrive, S3, WebDAV, SMB, SFTP, FTP, Immich, Seafile, Koofr, MEGA, and local storage.

Key Features:
- Zero-disk streaming transfers (no local temporary storage retention during migration)
- Multi-threaded background migrations and cron-based synchronization schedules
- Robust 3-way hash integrity verification & flexible conflict resolution
- Integrated cloud file manager with multi-format previews and thumbnails
- Multi-channel notification delivery (Gotify, ntfy, Telegram, Discord, Email)
- Enterprise-grade security with AES-256-GCM encryption, TOTP 2FA, and audit logging

compose:
services:
  frontend:
    image: ghcr.io/xxroxxerxx/clumoove-frontend:v0.19.0@sha256:8fbdb27158f4cfaabccf5b7f5f5866686dc3fb5e01bd40997f080b4facd6385a
    container_name: clumoove-frontend
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    environment:
      - CLUMOOVE_API_URL=
    depends_on:
      - api-backend
    networks:
      - clumoove-network
  api-backend:
    image: ghcr.io/xxroxxerxx/clumoove-api:v0.19.0@sha256:d5a30c51c5ac6684e6afc399ca5ab845338bc06ab14cc3873bdbd52e2d3478cf
    container_name: clumoove-api
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://clumoove:${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres-db:5432/cloud_migration_db?sslmode=disable
      - REDIS_URL=redis://:clumoove_secure_redis_pass@redis-queue:6379
      - PORT=8000
      - ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY=${SECRET_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY}
      - JWT_SECRET_KEY=${SECRET_JWT_SECRET_KEY}
      - TRUSTED_PROXY=1
      - LOCAL_STORAGE_ROOT=/clumoove
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/storage
        target: /clumoove
    depends_on:
      - postgres-db
      - redis-queue
    networks:
      - clumoove-network
  migration-worker:
    image: ghcr.io/xxroxxerxx/clumoove-worker:v0.19.0@sha256:680ba9935621eb032b6abd5d0d25472eddd2738222f35778fce86914d6a47662
    container_name: clumoove-worker
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["/app/worker"]
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://clumoove:${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres-db:5432/cloud_migration_db?sslmode=disable
      - REDIS_URL=redis://:clumoove_secure_redis_pass@redis-queue:6379
      - ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY=${SECRET_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY}
      - LOCAL_STORAGE_ROOT=/clumoove
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/storage
        target: /clumoove
    depends_on:
      - postgres-db
      - redis-queue
    networks:
      - clumoove-network
  postgres-db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine@sha256:fe0737ba566a2c5b2a28f34433c0a423261900ec17b9bf7ad115e1aae7e57f1b
    container_name: clumoove-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["postgres", "-c", "max_connections=300"]
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: clumoove
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: cloud_migration_db
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/postgres
        target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - clumoove-network
  redis-queue:
    image: redis:7-alpine@sha256:ff02b58f971e7d7d156a1267e283fcbbeee91773b6aa36c49dac28ecfe28eadf
    container_name: clumoove-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes --requirepass "clumoove_secure_redis_pass" --bind 0.0.0.0
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/redis
        target: /data
    networks:
      - clumoove-network
networks:
  clumoove-network:
    driver: bridge
